_comment: Recorded WeebCentral fetchPages() responses for the Task 7 volume-packer harness. The fake MangaScraper looks up a chapterId here and emits one PageInfo per entry in 'pages'. Each page name is resolved to a file:// URL under this fixtures directory so a REAL QNetworkAccessManager downloads it. The chapter 'number' documents what the packer independently parses out of the chapterId string (the numeric run) — 'wc-chapter-10' -> 10, 'wc-chapter-11' -> 11 -> filenames c010_* / c011_*. 'wc-chapter-12-missing' points a page at an on-disk file that does not exist, so its download fails and the volume never becomes ready.
